title: LLM08 Scanner Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the LLM08 Vector & Embedding Security Scanner. Validated at startup via jsonschema before any scan begins.

vector_db.description: Connection settings for the target vector database.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the vector DB service.

grpc_port.description: gRPC port (optional; Qdrant default is 6334). Set null to disable gRPC.

api_key.description: API key for authenticated vector DBs. Null for unauthenticated local instances.

tls.description: Whether to use TLS/HTTPS for the connection.

timeout_seconds.description: Request timeout in seconds for all vector DB operations.

embedding.description: Embedding model configuration used to encode attack queries and reconstruct vectors.

dimension.description: Output embedding dimension. Must match model output and vector DB collection dimension.

batch_size.description: Batch size for bulk encoding operations.

normalize.description: Whether to L2-normalize embeddings before storage and comparison. Required for DP noise injection (see DD-003).

tenants.description: List of tenants/namespaces to scan. Each tenant maps to one Qdrant collection.

name.description: Human-readable tenant identifier used in reports.

collection.description: Qdrant collection name for this tenant.

token.description: Simulated auth token for this tenant (used by ACL Fuzzer to impersonate). Null if not using token-based auth simulation.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this tenant's data domain.

acl_rules.description: Row-level security rules for the ACL Simulator. Each rule defines field-level access for a tenant.

tenant.description: Tenant name this rule applies to. Must match a name in the tenants list.

allowed_fields.description: Metadata fields this tenant is allowed to read.

denied_fields.description: Metadata fields this tenant must NOT be able to read (policy-enforced).

ip_allowlist.description: CIDR blocks allowed to query this tenant's collection. Empty = no IP restriction.

scoring_weights.description: Relative weights for each module's score in the overall risk aggregation. Must sum to 1.0.

thresholds.description: Detection thresholds for anomaly scoring modules.

collision_threshold.description: Cosine similarity above which two cross-tenant results are flagged as a near-duplicate collision.

mahalanobis_sigma.description: Number of standard deviations (Mahalanobis) above which a vector is flagged as an outlier.

dp_epsilon.description: Privacy budget ε for the Laplace differential-privacy noise injection. Lower = more noise = stronger privacy (but degrades utility). Typical range: 0.1–10.0.

poisoning_top_k.description: top-k retrieval count used when measuring over-retrieval rate during poisoning simulation.

probe_neighbor_k.description: Number of nearest neighbors retrieved per probe query during semantic-neighbor attack.

isolation_forest_contamination.description: Expected fraction of outliers in the dataset for IsolationForest training. Use 'auto' or a float in (0, 0.5].

probe_payloads.description: Configuration for the probe generator's attack query catalog.

seed_phrases.description: Seed phrases used to generate semantic-neighbor attack queries. If empty, the payload library uses its built-in defaults.

paraphrase_variants_per_seed.description: Number of paraphrase variants to generate per seed phrase.

output.description: Output artifact paths and format flags.

report_dir.description: Directory where PDF reports are written.

heatmap_dir.description: Directory where heatmap HTML and PNG files are written.

raw_json_dir.description: Directory where raw JSON findings are written.

generate_pdf.description: Whether to generate a PDF report in addition to JSON.

generate_heatmap.description: Whether to generate the vector-space heatmap visualization.

timestamp_format.description: Python strftime format string used to timestamp output filenames.
